assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production 2D pixel game animation sprite sheet, 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 separate cells, on true transparent background. Subject: MICHAEL, extremely cute chibi angel boy, oversized round head (nearly half body height), small gold blond fluffy hair, very large dark navy expressive eyes with white glints, tiny pink cheeks, small white angel wings, gold halo, white and gold miniature armor, cobalt blue short cape, gold short sword. Original high quality cozy fantasy JRPG pixel art. Not realistic adult anatomy. Orthographic side-scrolling three-quarter view always facing RIGHT, no perspective floor, no shadows under feet. Consistent SAME character head size, costume, weapon and body scale in ALL frames. Clear chunky square pixels, one pixel dark navy outlines, deliberately low-resolution sprite look (each character ~56 logical pixels high, enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor edges), small restrained palette, no gradients, no antialiasing. Composition: square 1024x1024 canvas exactly divided into 4x4 256x256 cells. Each cell's character feet touch invisible baseline at 216 pixels down inside cell, hips centered on x128 within cell; body/halo top around y40. All wings/sword inside each cell with generous margins, nothing touches neighboring cells. NO visible cell borders or guides. Cell poses in READING ORDER: row1: idle bright eyes sword lowered; idle tiny wing flutter body same height; running right left foot forward right foot back; running right feet passing under body. Row2: running right right foot forward left foot back; running right feet passing with heels up; jump rising knees tucked wings lifting; jump falling feet extended wings open. Row3: landed crouch; sword attack anticipation sword raised back; powerful sword cut forward right at waist height; sword follow-through arm extended low right. Row4: cast preparation sword raised toward halo; cast release sword upright wings wide; hurt recoil with squeezed eyes; defeated sitting crouched head bowed eyes closed (not horizontal corpse). Feet baseline consistent on all grounded frames. No detached effects, no painted sword arc, no text letters numbers watermarks background.
